svg.title: Autoprompt workflow
svg.desc: DIRECT, LIGHT, and ROADMAP routes lead to independent review and testing. Findings return to the affected work, plan, or checks; the updated version is checked again. Completion requires all checks to pass.

g.text: Automatic selection, or the path requested by the user
Check requirements before starting the selected route
Second checker only for a separate, named risk
Save a new version for checking
